        <script><![CDATA[var UserReferenceFilter = Class.create();
UserReferenceFilter.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    byGroupOrRole: function() {
        var groupId = '055c6bd89313cb106eea367efaba10a9';
        var roleId  = '22fc42e393728f906eea367efaba1066';
        var userMap = {};

        // Query Group Members
        var grMember = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        grMember.addQuery('group', groupId);
        grMember.query();
        while (grMember.next()) {
            userMap[grMember.getValue('user')] = true;
        }

        // Query Role Holders
        var grRole = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
        grRole.addQuery('role', roleId);
        grRole.addQuery('state', 'active');
        grRole.query();
        while (grRole.next()) {
            userMap[grRole.getValue('user')] = true;
        }

        var uniqueUsers = Object.keys(userMap);
        return uniqueUsers.length > 0 ? 'sys_idIN' + uniqueUsers.join(',') : 'sys_idINNULL';
    },

    type: 'UserReferenceFilter'
};]]></script>
